coreResponsibility.why: A Kaltura Player UI plugin that provides a minimal, specialized audio player interface for playing audio and video entries with a compact, audio-centric visualization.

featureOwnership: Audio waveform visualization via volume map bar
Audio entry metadata display (title, description, poster)
Audio-specific playback controls (play/pause, rewind, forward, volume)
Audio plugins overlay and plugin management system
Live audio stream support with live tag indicator
Error slate display for playback errors
dataHandling: MediaMetadata: poster, title, description from player sources
VolumeMapEntry: audio waveform data (pts timestamps, rms_level dB values)
AudioPluginDto: external plugin registrations for the overlay menu
Player state: playback status, current time, duration, error states

upstream: @playkit-js/kaltura-player-js - Core player framework and BasePlugin class
Kaltura Media Service API - Volume map data via /service/media/action/getVolumeMap
downstream: Kaltura Player embed applications consuming audio playback
Any UI requiring minimal audio player visualization
External plugins registering via AudioPluginsManager service
externalAPIs: Kaltura Media API (/service/media/action/getVolumeMap) - fetches audio waveform visualization data
hex-to-css-filter - color theming for player controls

entryPoints: src/index.ts - Plugin registration and preset initialization
src/components/audio-player-view/audio-player-view.tsx - Main view component with state management
src/data-manager.ts - Volume map data fetching and caching

errorPatterns: Plugin cannot be added due to invalid parameters
No entry ID found, cannot fetch volume map
